source_text: Si litigabunt duo et percusserint mulierem praegnantem, et exierit infans nondum formatus, detrimentum pendetur. Lex corporalis umbra est spiritalium.
pass_a_gloss: If will-quarrel two and will-have-struck woman pregnant, and will-have-exited infant not-yet formed, loss will-be-paid. Law bodily shadow is of-spiritual-things.
pass_b_english: [[If two men quarrel and strike a pregnant woman, and her child comes out not yet formed, a fine is paid >> Bible:Exodus 21:22]]. The bodily law is a shadow of spiritual things.
